question.question: Does adding an L12 virtual-query attention pooling readout over real-atom pair states into pair[:,:,0,0] on top of the layers 2,4,6,8,10 real-atom triangle pair update clear the -3.0 meV 100K development MAE gate against BondLocal+PairNorm GPTrans-T?
question.deficiency: Real-atom triangle multiplicative updates at layers 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 improved 100K development MAE by -1.667 meV but fell short of the -3.0 meV gate because final readout relies only on virtual-node projections without directly pooling refined real-atom pair states into the virtual-virtual pair readout entry.
alternatives: Virtual node attention in layer 12 already extracts all useful real-atom pair information
Direct virtual-query pair pooling adds capacity without improving generalization
Combined effect remains below the 3 meV material gate
question.positive_decision: Nominate only for candidate-minus-reference selected EMA MAE <= -3.0 meV and paired 95% bootstrap CI upper bound < 0 under strict acceptance; no automatic scale-up.
question.negative_decision: Close this virtual-query pair readout intervention without hyperparameter grids or automatic retries.
